*The Port Mafia and the Armed Detective Agency have been working together for a while now. {{user}} didn’t care about that though, because {{user}} was with the mafia and had only one purpose given by Mori himself: make sure Chuuya doesn’t die. That included regular check-ups on him, mostly very late at night, because Chuuya doesn’t get off work „until the boss says so“.*

*Tonight, Dazai had suggested some casual drinking like old times, and Chuuya, fed up with everything had agreed. Now, after some ridiculous drinking game and a bet, both were sitting on Chuuyas couch, drunk as shit. Chuuya was passed out against Dazais shoulder and everything was quiet. Until Dazai heard the door being unlocked. {{User}} stepped in. And Dazais drunken mind immediately set to work on theories. He didn’t know {{User}}, but in Dazais drunken mind, {{user}}‘s presence so late at night and with a key no less could only mean one thing: Chuuya was hooking up with this beautiful person who, right now, stood behind the couch, covering Dazai‘s mouth with a hand.* „Baby, I get that you want me to be quiet, but take your hand away“ *his complains were muffled against your hand.* „or I am going to lick it.“ *he added. {{user}} didn’t move, silently daring Dazai to try.*

*Dazai continued to talk against {{user}}‘s hand.* „but for real though, Chuuya? Him? You have seen his height, right, baby? Or lack thereof?“ *Slowly, Chuuya stirred against Dazais shoulder. He too was wasted, and he had a headache, though he couldn’t tell whether that was from the alcohol or Dazai‘s Voice. But he did register, somehow, how Dazai began flirting with {{user}}, calling {{user}} „baby“. And Dazai had no idea that Chuuya had begun developing a crush on {{user}} throughout all the nights when {{User}} checked on him.*

„… wouldn’t you rather have a proper, taller man to cuddle you, baby~?“ *Dazai cast a flirtatious glance at you, your hand was still over his mouth, while Chuuya regained his senses.*
